note: The IVF header byte is attacker-controlled and selects decoder controls that steer the decode path.
The chosen operating point is copied into sequence-header parsing and influences which operating point idc is active.
The active operating point idc is stored in decoder state and later used to filter OBUs.
The decoder must only enter the show-existing-frame path when the referenced frame buffer is fully initialized and valid.
The frame context is copied into the active entropy context and then consumed by decoding, exposing uninitialized state to MSan if the prerequisite frame state is invalid.
